SELECT 'PUR_REQUEST' AS kind, '구매요청' AS kind_label, r.request_no AS no, r.request_seq AS seq, COALESCE(pl.plant_name, '') AS label, r.reason_code AS reason_code, c.code_name AS reason_name, (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM tb_purchase_request_line l WHERE l.request_seq = r.request_seq) AS line_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.request_qty), 0)::int FROM tb_purchase_request_line l WHERE l.request_seq = r.request_seq) AS total_qty, r.requested_by AS requested_by, COALESCE(u.user_name, r.requested_by) AS requested_by_name, r.requested_at AS requested_at, DATE_PART('day', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - r.requested_at)::int AS waiting_days, pl.plant_name AS plant_name, 'PUR_REQ_APPROVE' AS approve_perm, 'purchase-requests' AS route FROM tb_purchase_request r LEFT JOIN tb_plant pl ON pl.plant_seq = r.plant_seq LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_id = r.requested_by LEFT JOIN tb_code_group cg ON cg.code_group_id = 'REASON_PURCHASE' LEFT JOIN tb_code c ON c.code_group_seq = cg.code_group_seq AND c.code_id = r.reason_code WHERE r.request_status = 'REQUESTED'
AND ( r.request_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR pl.plant_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR u.user_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY r.requested_at

SELECT 'INV_ADJUST' AS kind, '재고조정' AS kind_label, a.adjust_no AS no, a.adjust_seq AS seq, COALESCE(w.warehouse_name, '') AS label, a.reason_code AS reason_code, c.code_name AS reason_name, (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM tb_stock_adjust_line l WHERE l.adjust_seq = a.adjust_seq) AS line_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ABS(l.qty_delta)), 0)::int FROM tb_stock_adjust_line l WHERE l.adjust_seq = a.adjust_seq) AS total_qty, a.requested_by AS requested_by, COALESCE(u.user_name, a.requested_by) AS requested_by_name, a.requested_at AS requested_at, DATE_PART('day', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - a.requested_at)::int AS waiting_days, pl.plant_name AS plant_name, 'INV_ADJ_APPROVE' AS approve_perm, 'stock-adjusts' AS route FROM tb_stock_adjust a LEFT JOIN tb_warehouse w ON w.warehouse_seq = a.warehouse_seq LEFT JOIN tb_plant pl ON pl.plant_seq = w.plant_seq LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_id = a.requested_by LEFT JOIN tb_code_group cg ON cg.code_group_id = 'REASON_ADJUST' LEFT JOIN tb_code c ON c.code_group_seq = cg.code_group_seq AND c.code_id = a.reason_code WHERE a.adjust_status = 'REQUESTED'
AND ( a.adjust_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR w.warehouse_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR u.user_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY a.requested_at

SELECT 'INB_CORRECT' AS kind, '입고정정' AS kind_label, ic.correct_no AS no, ic.correct_seq AS seq, COALESCE(i.inbound_no, '') AS label, ic.reason_code AS reason_code, c.code_name AS reason_name, (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM tb_inbound_correct_line l WHERE l.correct_seq = ic.correct_seq) AS line_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ABS(l.qty_delta)), 0)::int FROM tb_inbound_correct_line l WHERE l.correct_seq = ic.correct_seq) AS total_qty, ic.requested_by AS requested_by, COALESCE(u.user_name, ic.requested_by) AS requested_by_name, ic.requested_at AS requested_at, DATE_PART('day', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - ic.requested_at)::int AS waiting_days, pl.plant_name AS plant_name, 'INB_CORRECTION' AS approve_perm, 'inbound-corrects' AS route FROM tb_inbound_correct ic LEFT JOIN tb_inbound i ON i.inbound_seq = ic.inbound_seq LEFT JOIN tb_plant pl ON pl.plant_seq = i.plant_seq LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_id = ic.requested_by LEFT JOIN tb_code_group cg ON cg.code_group_id = 'REASON_CORRECT' LEFT JOIN tb_code c ON c.code_group_seq = cg.code_group_seq AND c.code_id = ic.reason_code WHERE ic.correct_status = 'REQUESTED'
AND ( ic.correct_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR i.inbound_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR u.user_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY ic.requested_at
